notes.title: 1.0.2a
notes.notes:
Small QOL:
Upgrades now show "Max" when the cap is reached instead of a fake value.

[list]
[*] Bugfix for second boss where some projectiles would go in random, untelegraphed directions.
[*] Relatedly, changes to second boss where projectiles were now more easily dodgeable.
[/list]

[list][*][p]FPS improvements all around
[/p][/*][*][p]The sword and fireball upgrade don't live forever anymore, sadly.
[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies aren't looking for nonexistent references anymore, also sadly.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed upgraded Shuriken firing with Skyshot support each iteration. A bit too powerful it turns out.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the Axe Upgrade to give it more consistent clearing ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pustules could spawn outside of walking area.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.0a Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the health and armor of a few enemies.
[*]Sped up the pustule reward scrolling speed.
[*]Fix Spark upgrade with Skyshot support not moving.
[*]Fix for enemies on the second level not moving.
[/list]
There are reported FPS drops in later parts of levels, working on a fix.
